rows.label: Edge AI accelerator efficiency
rows.envelope: >=0.1 TOPS/W is a broad plausibility floor before accelerator selection.
rows.interpretation: 0.29 TOPS/W using total appliance power budget.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm workload precision, sustained throughput, accelerator SKU, thermal derating and host overhead.

rows.label: Rack power density
rows.envelope: <=1,000 W/U is plausible for dense air-cooled edge equipment before thermal proof.
rows.interpretation: 700 W/U rack density before thermal validation.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm inlet temperature, airflow, fan curve, acoustic limit, PSU derating and service clearance.
